title: Engine Oil Filter Housing — Removal
abstract: Removal of the oil filter housing from a Auran installation, with the oil drained to the working level and the heat shield taken off first so that the housing can be lifted clear of the pylon structure.

sections.purpose: This task gives the removal of the oil filter housing from the engine. Use it for housing replacement, for filter bowl work that cannot be done in place, or before the requalified housing is introduced.
sections.job_setup_note: Drain the oil to the level given in the servicing instruction rather than fully, so that the tank does not have to be re-primed. The housing is above head height and comes down with the oil still in its galleries, so have the catch tray and a second pair of hands. Let the engine cool for the time given before you start.
sections.procedure: WARNING: LET THE ENGINE COOL FOR THE TIME GIVEN IN THE JOB SET-UP BEFORE YOU OPEN THE OIL SYSTEM. HOT OIL UNDER RESIDUAL PRESSURE WILL SPRAY WHEN A COUPLING IS RELEASED. Open the fan cowl doors and support them on their stays. Drain the oil to the working level. Release the cowl latch CAD307983-03 and get access to the housing. Remove the forward clamp ZED715928-89 and the heat shield PED599919-30, keeping the shim pack at the heat shield mounting together and identified. Put the catch tray under the housing. Disconnect the oil lines at the housing and cap them immediately. CAUTION: CAP EVERY OPEN OIL LINE AS SOON AS IT IS DISCONNECTED. AN OPEN LINE WILL TAKE IN DEBRIS FROM THE NACELLE AND THE SYSTEM WILL THEN HAVE TO BE FLUSHED. Release the clamp kit D7920122286375 at the aft attachment and the inboard mount link D7920124662661, keeping the shims identified by position. Take the weight of the housing with two persons and lower it clear of the pylon structure. Inspect the mounting faces and the pylon structure behind the housing and report any finding. Fit blanking caps to all open ports.
sections.close_out: Put the removed housing on the workbench with its caps in place. Keep the shim packs from the heat shield and the mount link identified by position, because the installation clearance depends on them. Record the oil drained and the inspection findings. Leave the cowl doors on their stays or closed and pinned.

type_data.effectivity_note: Auran installations on TTN-88W1 and TTN-88W2 aircraft. The CVX-7200 installation uses a different housing and a different task.

safety_precautions: Let the engine cool for the time given before you open the oil system.
Support the fan cowl doors on their stays.
Cap every open oil line as soon as it is disconnected.

title: Engine Oil Filter Housing — Removal

issue.reason: Job set-up note records that the removal cannot be run alongside forward mount bore work at the same pylon opening.
